content: Standard pnpm design-system monorepo: apps/ + packages/ split, pnpm-workspace.yaml at root, workspace:* protocol for internal deps, dev tooling (TS/ESLint/Prettier) centralized at root or in a shared config package. Build order follows the dependency graph; Turborepo (or plain pnpm -r with topological ordering) derives it automatically: tokens/styles -> component packages -> docs app. Cross-checked across pnpm docs, Nx blog, and multiple monorepo guides.
